name: protoc-gen-es
description: TypeScript/JavaScript protoc plugin (@bufbuild/protoc-gen-es) used by packages/proto codegen (local plugin, no BSR fetch)
installHint: Installed via `npm install --prefix ~/.cache/vrooli/protoc-plugins/node @bufbuild/protoc-gen-es@2.12.0` then symlinked to ~/.local/bin/protoc-gen-es. Requires Node on PATH (handled by the `node` host tool).
notes: Pinned alongside buf.gen.yaml; bump in lockstep with the proto-codegen byte-stability gate (`make check`).
